Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just go by the claim number on this one, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving down the main road in Pasadena, Texas, heading toward the shopping center. Traffic had slowed
down ahead of a light.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I had come to a stop behind a pickup. I checked my mirror and then felt my car get hit from behind, pretty hard.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before it hit you?
A: Not really. I only saw it in the mirror for a second, and it looked like it was going too fast for the traffic.
Q: Were you able to drive your car away from the scene?
A: It was drivable, but the back bumper was pushed in and the trunk wouldn't close right. A tow truck took it.
Q: How are you feeling physically since the accident?
A: My neck is sore and stiff. When I turn my head to the left, I get a sharp pain going down toward my shoulder. I also
have a headache most mornings.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same afternoon, and I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week
since then.
Q: Have you had any problems with your neck or back before this collision?
A: I had some stiffness years ago from sleeping wrong, but nothing that stopped me from working or doing my normal
activities.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know?
A: Just that I've missed a few days of work because I can't sit at my desk for long periods without my neck aching.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Okay, thank you.
</page>

- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.
